# Datasets in the GMCI Collection

All datasets of the GMCI collection are listed in the table below. By clicking on the column headers it is possible to filter for the desired specifications. 

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(DT)

column_names <- c("Name", "Size of Collection", "Sample Size", "Dimension", "Task", "Data Type", "Dataset Scope", "Ground Truth", "Temporal Structure", "License", "Missing Values")

# https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17854235
d <- c(sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17854235", "DREAM5 - Gene Network Inference - E. coli"), 
        NA, NA, 4155,
        "Causal Discovery", 
        "Mixed Data", 
        "Collection of Datasets", 
        "Unknown Graph", 
        "Static Data", 
        "CC BY-ND 4.0", 
        "No Missing Values")
d <- rbind(d, c(sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17854235", "DREAM5 - Gene Network Inference - S. aureus"), 
        NA, NA, 2810,
        "Causal Discovery", 
        "Mixed Data", 
        "Collection of Datasets", 
        "Unknown Graph", 
        "Static Data", 
        "CC BY-ND 4.0", 
        "No Missing Values"))
d <- rbind(d, c(sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17854235", "DREAM5 - Gene Network Inference - S. cerevisiae"), 
        NA, NA, 5950,
        "Causal Discovery", 
        "Mixed Data", 
        "Collection of Datasets", 
        "Unknown Graph", 
        "Static Data", 
        "CC BY-ND 4.0", 
        "No Missing Values"))
d <- rbind(d, c(sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17854235", "DREAM5 - Gene Network Inference - in silico"), 
        NA, NA, 1643,
        "Causal Discovery", 
        "Mixed Data", 
        "Collection of Datasets", 
        "Unknown Graph", 
        "Static Data", 
        "CC BY-ND 4.0", 
        "No Missing Values"))


# https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17672001
d <- rbind(d, c(sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17672001", "Causal Chamber™"),
        59, 1000, 46,
        "Causal Discovery", 
        "Mixed Data", 
        "Collection of Datasets", 
        "Known Graph", 
        "Static Data", 
        "CC BY 4.0", 
        "No Missing Values"))

colnames(d) <- column_names
datasets <- as.data.frame(d)
datasets$`Size of Collection` <- as.numeric(datasets$`Size of Collection`)
for (i in 1:9) {
  if (i %in% 2:4) {
    datasets[, i] <- as.numeric(datasets[, i])
  }
  else {
    datasets[, i] <- as.factor(datasets[, i])
  }
}
row.names(datasets) <- NULL

datatable(
  datasets,
  filter = "top",
  escape = FALSE,   # allow HTML in cells
  options = list(pageLength = 10)
)

```
